sources.title: Travelling to Niue
sources.officialityEvidence: Niue Tourism's current visitor-entry page identifies its Immigration Office and publishes the visa-waiver list, arrival-permit conditions, and the incompatible New Zealand FAQ result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: including New Zealand ... do not need a visa for tourist stays up to 30 days

sources.title: Passports and visas | SafeTravel
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade, New Zealand
sources.officialityEvidence: SafeTravel is New Zealand MFAT's live overseas-travel service; its current passport-and-visa guidance explains that the destination authority controls visitor visa requirements.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa requirements are set by the destination (or transit) country

conflicts.officialStatus: unresolved: the current Niue page gives incompatible New Zealand outcomes
conflicts.explanation: The detailed visa-waiver list omits New Zealand and says all other travellers need a prior visitor visa, while the same page's FAQ expressly includes New Zealand in visa-waiver countries. The ordinary-passport baseline cannot be normalized.

unresolved.reason: The replayed SafeTravel page is risk guidance, not a New Zealand-passport visitor issuance rule. No current Afghan authority establishes both liability and an available issuance route.
No current New Zealand or Central African authority identifies an ordinary New Zealand visitor route and actual advance, electronic, or arrival issuance timing.
Chad's current eVisa material does not supply an exact New Zealand ordinary-passport liability or entitlement result; application availability is not a cohort rule.
Mali's current assistant is a mutable residence-and-filing workflow and does not safely establish an ordinary New Zealand visitor route or actual issuance timing.
No current New Zealand or Niger authority maps an ordinary New Zealand passport to a short-visitor route and issuance timing; no exemption complement is inferred.
No current New Zealand or DPRK authority establishes ordinary New Zealand visitor issuance and operational availability. Permission and sponsor requirements are not normalized as a visitor baseline.
SafeTravel contains no New Zealand-passport entry route, and no current Sudanese authority establishes an available ordinary visitor issuance channel.
No current New Zealand or Turkmen authority joins the ordinary New Zealand passport to a visitor outcome and a physical or electronic issuance point; invitation-only material is insufficient.
No current New Zealand or São Tomé authority establishes ordinary New Zealand visitor eligibility and electronic, mission, or border issuance timing.
SafeTravel's Syria page supplies safety material only. No current Syrian authority identifies ordinary New Zealand visitor issuance timing.
Burkina Faso's eVisa portal does not publish an exact ordinary New Zealand eligibility and issuance result. Portal availability is not used as a nationality rule.
Liberia's current airport route is mission/residence-dependent and does not establish a nationality-wide ordinary New Zealand visitor baseline.
Côte d'Ivoire's online pre-enrolment and airport-printing material does not identify ordinary New Zealand-passport eligibility or select issuance timing.
South Sudan's eVisa workflow does not publish an ordinary New Zealand eligibility result. A generic electronic application process is not a nationality-terminal route.
Federal and Kurdistan entry routes are materially different, and no current authority establishes one ordinary New Zealand country-wide visitor status and issuance point.
Comorian law does not identify ordinary New Zealand visitor eligibility or physical arrival issuance; airport and port wording is limited to transit visas.
No current New Zealand or Guinea-Bissau authority identifies ordinary New Zealand visitor treatment and actual advance, electronic, or arrival issuance timing.
No current New Zealand or Iranian authority maps an ordinary New Zealand passport to one visitor issuance route. Generic electronic and mission services are not normalized.
No current Trinidad and Tobago authority publishes an exhaustive ordinary New Zealand passport rule; CARICOM and omitted-nationality treatment is not transferred.
Djibouti's eVisa system supplies no exact ordinary New Zealand eligibility result and does not resolve the separate border route.

The current Niue page omits New Zealand from its detailed visitor-permit list but its FAQ says New Zealand is included; it also distinguishes Niuean-origin and resident New Zealand passports. This is not one ordinary-passport baseline.
No official source establishes one Palestinian Territory-wide New Zealand visitor route. Israeli-controlled crossings, permits and territory-specific access remain material.
No current North Macedonia or New Zealand authority directly maps an ordinary New Zealand passport to a visitor route; Schengen and third-country-document rules are not transferred.
No current Tunisia or New Zealand authority establishes ordinary New Zealand short-visitor exemption or actual alternative issuance timing.
No current BVI authority affirmatively maps an ordinary New Zealand passport to visitor treatment. UK rules and third-country-document routes are not transferred.
